from pathlib import Path
import ast,hashlib,json,re
r=Path.cwd();f=r/'docs/testing';t=r/'target/lua-native-hooks';sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest();reports={};data={}
def read(suffix):
 p=f/f'2026-10-28-rust-lua-file-payloads-{suffix}.json';d=json.loads(p.read_text());data[suffix]=d;reports[suffix]=dict(path=p.relative_to(r).as_posix(),sha256=sha(p));return d
def sources(d):
 for name,h in d.get('source_hashes',{}).items():assert sha(r/name)==h,name
def artifacts(d):
 for name,h in d.get('artifacts',{}).items():assert sha(Path(name))==h,name
linux=read('i686-verification');assert linux['artifact_hashes_verified']and linux['source_hashes_verified']and linux['checked_references_enabled']and linux['preactivation_file_verified']and linux['signed_ftell_verified']and linux['pointer_bits']==32
stats=[]
for profile in ['focused','current','i686-current']:
 for prefix,count,marker in [('',26,b'file-payloads-exit'),('native-',47,b'native-files-exit')]:
  name=prefix+profile;d=read(name);sources(d)
  if profile!='i686-current':artifacts(d)
  else:assert reports[name]['sha256']==linux['reports']['file-payloads'+('-native'if prefix else'')]['sha256']
  assert d['observations_equal']and len({row['stdout_hex']for row in d['runs'].values()})==1
  lines=bytes.fromhex(d['runs']['rust']['stdout_hex']).splitlines();assert len(lines)==count+1 and lines[-1]==b'complete\t'+str(count).encode()
  if not prefix:assert d['runs']['rust']['command'][-1]=='rust'and lines[0]==b'before.C\tclosed file\tfalse\tfile (closed)'
  for engine,row in d['runs'].items():assert row['returncode']==0 and (engine=='rust'or not row['stderr_hex'])
  match=re.fullmatch(r'NATIVE_FILES operations=(\d+) states=(\d+) groups=(\d+) libraries=(\d+)\n',bytes.fromhex(d['runs']['rust']['stderr_hex']).decode());assert match
  stats.append(dict(zip(['operations','states','groups','libraries'],map(int,match.groups()))))
  assert set(d['exit_runs'])=={'reference','checked','rust'}
  for row in d['exit_runs'].values():assert row['returncode']==7 and bytes.fromhex(row['stdout_hex'])==marker and not row['stderr_hex']
  if profile!='i686-current':
   checked=next(command for command in d['builds']if any(arg.startswith('/FI')for arg in command));header=Path(next(arg[3:]for arg in checked if arg.startswith('/FI')));assert '#define lua_assert(e)'in header.read_text()and'exit(86)'in header.read_text()
   src=r/'target/lua-cli-reference/lua-5.1.5/src'
   for name,h in d['reference_source_hashes'].items():assert sha(src/name)==h,name
   prior=json.loads((f/'2026-10-28-rust-lua-native-files-evidence.json').read_text())
   pinned=json.loads((r/prior['reports']['current']['path']).read_text())
   assert d['reference_source_hashes']==pinned['reference_source_hashes']
baseline=read('baseline');artifacts(baseline)
assert baseline['commit']=='45d98685864144ca9829bc8a6dad7b3ded224de9'and baseline['returncode']==0
assert bytes.fromhex(baseline['stdout_hex'])==b'false\n'and bytes.fromhex(baseline['expected_stdout_hex'])==b'true\n'
prior=r/baseline['reference_report'];assert sha(prior)==baseline['reference_report_sha256']
v=read('validation');sources(v);assert v['sources_unchanged']
for row in v['runs']:assert row['returncode']==0 and sha(Path(row['log']))==row['log_sha256'],row['name']
counts={row['name']:row['passed']for row in v['runs']if row['name'].endswith('-tests')};assert counts=={'windows-tests':815,'linux-x64-tests':816,'linux-i686-tests':816},counts
first=read('validation-first');assert reports['validation-first']['sha256']==v['first_report_sha256']
failure=next(row for row in first['runs']if row['name']=='windows-tests');assert failure['returncode']==101 and sha(Path(failure['log']))==failure['log_sha256']
